mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type='SDK_REQUEST' AND evaluation_time>=#{start} AND evaluation_time<#{end}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_alert_occurrence(occurrence_type,metric_code,dimension_key,sample_count,completeness,evaluation_snapshot,evaluation_time,created_at) VALUES ('HOURLY_BASELINE',#{row.metric},#{row.dimension},#{row.sampleCount},1,JSON_OBJECT('calculatedAt',NOW(3)),#{row.start},NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sample_count=VALUES(sample_count),completeness=1,evaluation_snapshot=JSON_OBJECT('calculatedAt',NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT dimension_key,evaluation_time bucket_start,sample_count FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type='HOURLY_BASELINE' AND metric_code=#{metric} AND dimension_key IN #{dimension} AND evaluation_time>=#{start} AND evaluation_time<#{end}
